assumptions: Sister-page overlap is treated as a brief-fit issue ('do not reuse March or August sentences'), not a rubric blocking issue, because the 12-word originality rule covers competitor pages. It is fixed by edits either way.

External links number 16 against the link-rules range of 2 to 5. Accepted because the brief requires each official figure to be linked at the claim, as on the March and August pages. All are government or met-service sources, none competitors.
'Quieter' harbours and promenade, 'close of the island season' and Europe 'winding down its season' are kept as the brief's framing of the late-season trade-off. They state no figure or date.
The at-a-glance table names stations but not periods. The brief asks for the station only, the planner's verify note asks for periods as well, and the brief takes precedence. Optional for the writer.
Edits carry exact old and new strings, as well as the schema's location, issue and fix fields.
